headline: Has PPG Industries (PPG) Fallen Far Enough To Trade Below Fair Value?
summary: PPG Industries stock has declined about 24% over the past five years, yet current valuation work suggests the shares may now trade below an estimate of intrinsic value based on a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model and earnings multiples. Over five years the share price is down roughly 24%. This means recent gains have not fully offset a longer period of weaker returns for long term holders. headline: Does PPG’s Steady Earnings, Dividend Hike And Buybacks Reshape Its Capital Allocation Story (PPG)?
summary: PPG Industries, Inc. has reported past second quarter 2026 results showing sales of US$4,495 million versus US$4,195 million a year earlier, with net income easing to US$437 million and earnings per share broadly flat. Alongside reaffirming its full-year 2026 earnings guidance and increasing its quarterly dividend to US$0.74, PPG continued buybacks, completing US$956.61 million of repurchases since 2024.
